specs.title: FR13-BVA-05 [edge] a delivered order of 0.01 increases revenue by 0.01, not by a rounded 0

annotations.description: Sub-unit amount. Two separate sources of imprecision, neither of which may be widened to hide the doubling: the column stores 0.01 as 0.009999999776482582 (single-precision float, ~2e-10 error), and the UI renders through toLocaleString(), which caps at 3 fraction digits. 3 decimal places is therefore the tightest the RENDERED figure can be asserted to - not a chosen tolerance but a ceiling the display imposes. It still separates 0.01 from 0.02.
